_description: SendGrid email-activity export → AKSI control ID mapping. SendGrid is the leading transactional + marketing email platform; AI agents push notifications, summaries, support replies, and marketing campaigns through it. Email + agents combines CAN-SPAM compliance (US — required physical address, opt-out mechanism, and recorded consent for marketing), sender-reputation hygiene (spam_report and reputation bounces directly degrade IP / domain reputation), and GDPR consent territory (legitimate-interest is a flagged basis; cross-border marketing without explicit opt-in is high-risk). Status, categories (transactional vs marketing), is_marketing, consent_basis, asm_group_id (unsubscribe group), and bounce_classification drive additive control findings. Marketing emails delivered without recorded consent (consent_basis=null) are surfaced as DE-01 FAIL — direct CAN-SPAM violation indicator. spam_report (recipient marked the email as spam) is the top-priority sender-reputation event (DE-01 FAIL). Marketing emails sent without an attached unsubscribe group (asm_group_id missing) are PR-05 FAIL — CAN-SPAM requires a working opt-out. Velocity (>N emails to the same recipient in 24h), cross-country fan-out (one api_key_id touching >N distinct recipient countries), and high bounce-rate-per-100 generate synthetic findings. Email addresses are NEVER stored in full — only the @domain portion survives (PII reduction). Subject text is dropped entirely (subject_length only); event-list IPs are masked to /16; raw event payloads are reduced to count + types.
